purpose: Independent verification of the derived deterministic counting property, and of the claim that this campaign's own earlier null at r=4/5/6 was an artifact of a mis-specified object.
verified_by: dispatching session (Bash), own from-scratch implementation - coordinator-side corroboration, NOT independent validation under 0137a051

the_dispute.prior_run: GATE-RR78-1 measured n = 2147497085 at r=4 (~2^31, random-looking) and read null at r=4, 5 and 6 at 1 trial per arm.
the_dispute.new_derivation: forces n = 0 EXACTLY at r=4 for every key, base and output-word index.
the_dispute.named_defect: GATE-RR78-1 encrypted under the convention where the final round DROPS MixColumns, but projected onto an output space that is the correct one only when the final round KEEPS it. Under the drop convention that condition does not pull back through SubBytes at all, because the pulled-back space is not byte-aligned. The matching space is the inverse-ShiftRows diagonals. The two halves of the instrument were algebraically incompatible.
the_dispute.why_r4_is_the_discriminator: The two objects give 0 and ~2^31 at the same round. That is not a resolution question; only one of them can be the object.

r4.finding: PERFECT BIJECTION. All 2^32 inputs map onto all 2^32 output values, each hit exactly once. Stronger than 'zero collisions' - the map from the diagonal coset to the ciphertext word at 4 rounds is a bijection.
r4.verdict: Matches the derivation exactly. Contradicts the prior run's ~2^31. THE PRIOR NULL WAS AN ARTIFACT.

r5.finding: The derived mod-8 property HOLDS on my own implementation and my own seed. The count is nonzero and near 2^31, so it is not a degenerate constant.

combined_evidence_for_r5.producer_result: all 6 read n = 0 mod 8, on counts differing from each other by ~1e5
combined_evidence_for_r5.note: The producer's 6 and my 1 use different implementations, different seeds and different key/base derivations.

what_this_establishes: A DERIVED, DETERMINISTIC counting property of 5-round AES-128: the number of colliding pairs of a diagonal coset under projection onto an inverse-ShiftRows ciphertext diagonal is forced to 0 mod 8. It is one round deeper than the deterministic 4-round ladder and, unlike the campaign's statistical 12-17x adaptive object, it rests on an argument that also predicts its own death round.
what_this_does_NOT_establish: NOVELTY. Not assessed, not assessable here - no primary source is reachable. The symmetric prohibition applies in both directions.
That r=6 is dead at good resolution. The producer read 7 and 4 on two trials; a further check is running. Two trials is thin.
The derivation itself as verified by me. I verified its PREDICTIONS at r=4 and r=5; I did not check the proof of the mod-8 orbit argument line by line.
Any key recovery. certificate.kind is none.
Anything about full-round or deployed AES.
honest_limits_carried_from_the_producer: 6 trials at r=5 rather than the pre-registered 20: achieved p = 8^-6, not 2^-60.
The r=3 exact count is invalid_measurement from counter saturation, recorded as void rather than as a null.
Five arms were not run before the halt, including the independent-round-key null and the random-plaintext null. A budget halt is not a null result.
